system.description:
Deal [(SR+3)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target.

(Extra): Secondary targets (excluding the initial target) within a range of [Target: Two / Range: 2 Sq.] from you take 10 direct damage. This damage triggers [Pursuit] once on the secondary target, as if they had failed their [Dodge Check].

A special skill that makes the wind an ally and releases a shock wave along with the attack. A crescent-shaped wave spreads out and engulfs many enemies.
